name: Churchill Farms Retail Center
summary: Churchill Farms Retail Center is a neighborhood shopping destination serving the rapidly growing Katy-Fulshear corridor along FM 1463. The center provides convenient retail and service options for the area's expanding residential communities.
demographics: Churchill Farms Retail Center serves the rapidly growing Katy-Fulshear corridor, attracting primarily middle to upper-middle income families with household incomes ranging from $75,000 to $150,000. The trade area is characterized by young families with children, many relocating to the area for its highly-rated schools and newer housing developments. Shoppers in this area tend to prioritize convenience and quality, seeking everyday services and dining options close to their suburban neighborhoods, with a preference for national chains mixed with local businesses.
description: Churchill Farms Retail Center is a neighborhood shopping destination strategically located at 4030 Farm to Market 1463 in the thriving Katy-Fulshear area of Texas. Situated in one of the Houston metropolitan area's fastest-growing corridors, this retail center serves the expanding residential communities that have transformed this region into a sought-after suburban destination. The center provides convenient access to essential services and retail options for the families and professionals who call this area home. With its location along FM 1463, Churchill Farms benefits from excellent visibility and accessibility, making it a natural stopping point for residents throughout the surrounding neighborhoods. The center maintains a strong reputation in the community, reflected in its 4-star rating, and continues to serve as a valued retail hub in this dynamic and growing market.
